scope: Computer science paper-figure collection, executable component libraries, LLM-assisted vectorization, generation and recursive self-improvement.
evidence_policy: Paper methods, dataset sizes and author benchmarks remain author claims unless explicitly independently verified.
Static source inspection is not runtime validation. No model inference, paid image generation, training, benchmark reproduction or bulk corpus collection was performed.
Proposed dataset sizes, architectures and evaluation designs are recommendations, not achieved capabilities.
Mutable web pages and dataset cards were read on the research date. Pinned OXR source files and selected downloaded text have hashes below.
Failed HTTP/TLS probes were preserved; no certificate verification bypass was used.
The initial broad survey has a separate index, sources.json. Counts in the two indexes overlap and must not be added as unique totals.

findings: The author workflow diagram describes error/uncertainty selection, attribution and clustering, targeted data generation and post-training feedback.
At this commit, inspected Picture recognition/postprocessing saves cropped image assets and returns image references rather than semantic figure objects.

A search of the checked file tree and focused source inspection did not identify a complete RSI attribution, synthesis and post-training pipeline. This is bounded evidence for this commit, not a claim about private code.
The license contains Apache-2.0 plus additional commercial, attribution and competing hosted API terms.
